title: The Donkey and the Salt

full_text:
Nasruddin loaded his donkey with heavy sacks of salt. While crossing a stream, the donkey slipped, and the salt dissolved in the water. Finding its load delightfully light, the cunning beast leaped out in joy.

The next day, the donkey deliberately tumbled into the stream again to dissolve the load.

Seeing through the trick, Nasruddin loaded the donkey with large bales of dry sponges the following morning.

When the donkey plunged into the river, the sponges absorbed gallons of water, multiplying the weight fivefold! The drenched animal barely managed to crawl ashore, cured forever of playing tricks.
moral: Tricks that seek to shirk duty eventually turn into heavier burdens.
